//: Allowlist for check-duplicate-names.ts. Every entry MUST include a `reason` (>=10 chars) explaining why the similarity is intentional — the forced justification is the point of this file.

allow.reason: Two distinct tRPC sub-routers for the todo-list domain: todoRouter exposes per-todo operations, todoListRouter exposes list-level operations. Both canonical.
todoRouter is the tRPC sub-router; todoHttpRouter is a Hono sub-app for raw HTTP endpoints (file upload, import). Different transports for the same domain.
inviteCollaborator is the service function that creates the invite row; inviteCollaboratorTemplate renders the email body. Service vs template-renderer — different layers.
Canonical CASL-rules convention: every domain exports applyXRules(({can, cannot}), user). Consistent signature by design.
Parent/child CRUD in the todo-list domain: TodoList is the container, Todo is the item. Same CRUD verbs apply to both; the names correctly distinguish which entity is being operated on.
Parent/child orchestration hooks: useTodoLists drives list-level UI, useTodos drives item-level UI within a selected list.
Auth UI pair — sign-in form and sign-up form are conventionally paired components.
Orthogonal hooks on the same domain: useTodoLists is the CRUD orchestrator; useTodoListLiveUpdates wires realtime subscription fan-out. Different responsibilities within one feature.
